line: Crowley's Atu VIII, formerly Justice: Libra under Venus, the letter Lamed, and the balance Crowley calls the feminine complement of the Fool.

sections.title: What Crowley says the card is
sections.line: Retitled from Justice; Libra under Venus, with Saturn exalted. The letter Lamed comes from the table; the text reaches it only through Aleph Lamed. The text gives no path ends; the Key Scale gives path 22.

quotes.quote: This card in the old pack was called Justice.
This card represents the sign of Libra, ruled by Venus; in it Saturn is exalted.
The equilibrium of all things is hereby symbolized.

sections.title: What the card figures
sections.line: Crowley's account of the balance the card symbolizes and of its relation to the Fool.

quotes.quote: the letters Aleph Lamed constitute the secret key of the Book of the Law
this card is the feminine complement of the Fool
Nature is not just, according to any theological or ethical idea; but Nature is exact.
In this sense, Nature is scrupulously just.
